name: whatsapp-reader
description: Lets Claude read your WhatsApp chats on this Mac, voice notes in German and English included.
long_description: Reads the WhatsApp app for Mac, read-only, and turns voice notes into text on your own Mac. Needs the WhatsApp app from the App Store linked to your phone, and Full Disk Access for Claude.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the most recently active WhatsApp chats

tools.name: read_chat
tools.description: Read recent messages from a person or group, voice notes transcribed

tools.name: open_media
tools.description: Show a photo, document or video from a chat
